notes: Tablets connect with a short address and a code typed on the computer – no long link to scan; setup’s QR codes are bigger and easier to scan
When to show: picking a widget for other times adds a hidden one to hold its settings if there isn’t one, and it can’t be removed while it’s in use; the list says which is which
Adding a widget shows straight away in Family Admin
Setup: after Deploy, copy the Web app URL and paste it into the setup page to connect – no Sheet menu needed
Setup and help: what to do if Deploy just spins or Google keeps asking for permission
Family Admin: moving widgets and pages happens instantly, and saved changes show straight away while they’re saved in the background – several quick taps are all kept, in order
